tieu_de: Sr/Expert AI Engineer Data Scientist, Python - 4B063
dia_chi_raw: Số 54A Nguyễn Chí Thanh, Phường Láng
mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are building customer-facing and internal AI products that directly impact growth, risk, operations, and customer experience in a regulated fintech environment.
As a Senior / Expert AI Platform Engineer, you will lead the delivery of LLM-powered products such as chatbots, voicebots, and analytics co-pilots, while ensuring they are production-grade, compliant, and measurable.
This is a product-heavy role: success is defined by business outcomes, not just infrastructure.
You will work end-to-end across data → model → product → monitoring, partnering closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Engineering teams.What Youʼll Build:
Customer-facing AI used by millions of users, AI assistants embedded in critical fintech workflows, A trusted, compliant AI platform adopted across the company, Measurable business impact across growth, cost, and riskWhy Join Us:
Build real AI products, not demos, Direct ownership of business-critical systems, Strong executive sponsorship for AI & GenAI, Modern stack: AWS Bedrock, dbt, Airflow, MLflow, High trust, high impact, expert-level autonomyMain Responsibilities include:
1. AI Products & Customer Journeys
Own the design and implementation of AI-driven products
Customer service chatbots & voicebots
Internal analytics & decisioning co-pilots
AI assistants for operations, sales, and risk teams
Translate business problems (conversion, cost-to-serve, fraud, credit decisioning, CX) into AI solutions
Design LLM workflows using RAG, agents, tools, and structured reasoning
Integrate models via AWS Bedrock with strict controls on latency, cost, and reliability
2. Fintech-Grade AI & ML Platform
Build and evolve a shared AI & ML platform supporting:
Predictive ML (risk, fraud, personalization)
LLM & GenAI workloads
Productionize models with strong MLOps practices:
Experiment tracking & model registry (MLflow)
CI/CD for models, prompts, and agents
Orchestrate data & ML pipelines using Airflow
Enable analytics, features, and training datasets using dbt
Support both real-time inference and batch decisioning
3. Risk, Governance & Compliance (Critical)
Design AI systems aligned with fintech governance requirements:
Model versioning, traceability, and auditability
Explainability and decision logging where required
Implement guardrails for:
Hallucination control & safe completion
Data privacy & PII protection
Model misuse and prompt injection
Partner with Risk, Compliance, and Legal to enable safe GenAI adoption
Support internal reviews, validations, and regulator-ready documentation
4. Monitoring, Quality & Continuous Improvement
Define and operate AI observability:
Model & prompt performance
Drift, bias, and degradation
Latency & cost efficiency
Build feedback loops from users, agents, and business teams
Continuously improve prompts, models, and product experience
